dict.string: Land finds your other computers on this network so you can send them files.
Island brings up the terminal tab a chat runs in, types the replies you send from the island, and restarts or shuts down this Mac when you ask from your phone.
Island's Bluetooth switch turns Bluetooth on and off, connects your headphones and shows their battery.
Island shows your next event and your week from the calendars on this Mac.
